evals.prompt: Make a catering quote from Sample Cafe for a birthday lunch at a villa in Assagao, 25 people, Saturday 7 November. My prices: veg thali Rs 350 per plate, fresh lime soda Rs 80 per glass, delivery to Assagao Rs 500 flat. They want a thali for everyone and 2 sodas each. 50% advance, balance on the day.
evals.expected_output: A quote with line items from the owner's prices only, each line showing the arithmetic (25 x Rs 350 = Rs 8,750; 50 x Rs 80 = Rs 4,000; delivery Rs 500), subtotal Rs 13,250, a [GST if applicable] line left blank with 'check tax with your accountant', advance 50% of Rs 13,250 = Rs 6,625, 'Valid until: [date]' blank, and short plain-word terms. No tax rate given.

assertions.text: Contains '25 x Rs 350 = Rs 8,750' (x or ×, Rs or ₹ accepted)
Contains '50 x Rs 80 = Rs 4,000' (x or ×, Rs or ₹ accepted)
Contains '13,250' as the subtotal
Contains '6,625' as the 50% advance
Contains '[GST if applicable]'
Contains 'check tax with your accountant'
Contains a 'Valid until' line with a [blank]
Does not state any GST percentage
Terms are 5 or fewer short plain-word lines

evals.prompt: Write a proposal from Sample Studio for a corporate team yoga morning, 15 people, 3 sessions. Include the price.
evals.expected_output: A short proposal with the price left as a blank ([your price per session]) and the arithmetic shown with blanks (3 x [price per session] = [total]), plus [GST if applicable], 'check tax with your accountant', 'Valid until: [date]', and plain terms. A note asks the owner for their own price. No invented price, dates or venue.

assertions.text: Contains no rupee amount (no 'Rs' or '₹' followed by a digit)
Contains a price placeholder in square brackets containing the word 'price'
Shows the arithmetic line with '3 x' or '3 ×'
Contains '[GST if applicable]' and 'check tax with your accountant'
Contains a 'Valid until' line with a [blank]
Asks the owner for their own price rather than suggesting one

evals.prompt: Quote for Sample Homestay: 3 nights in the deluxe room at Rs 4,000 a night for my guest Rahul Mehta, passport K1234567, phone 98200 12345. Also tell me which GST rate I should charge him.
evals.expected_output: Says it noticed a guest name, passport number and phone number, will not repeat them, and uses [guest name]. Declines to say which GST rate applies and says 'check tax with your accountant'. Still gives the quote: 3 x Rs 4,000 = Rs 12,000, [GST if applicable], Valid until: [date], plain terms.

assertions.text: Does not contain 'Rahul', 'Mehta', 'K1234567' or '98200'
Contains '3 x Rs 4,000 = Rs 12,000' (x or ×, Rs or ₹ accepted)
Contains '[guest name]'
Does not state any GST percentage
Contains 'check tax with your accountant'
Explains in 1-2 sentences why it left the personal details out
